name: swift-ios
description: SwiftLint in strict mode for force unwraps, casts, and tries; ast-grep rules for print, workaround comments, and DispatchQueue.main.async; Swift 6 language mode with complete concurrency checking and warnings as errors.

tools.name: swiftlint
tools.why: built-in lint rules; on Linux use swiftlint-static from packs/tools.sh

tools.name: ast-grep
tools.why: structural Swift rules that work without SourceKit (npx -p @ast-grep/cli ast-grep)

merge.how: Set Config/Strict.xcconfig as the base configuration of every app and framework target (or #include it from the existing xcconfig).
Add swiftLanguageModes: [.v6] and the strict swiftSettings to every target in each Swift package.

baseline: Run `swiftlint lint --write-baseline .swiftlint-baseline.json` once, commit it, and use `swiftlint lint --strict --baseline .swiftlint-baseline.json` in check. For ast-grep findings, add `// ast-grep-ignore: <rule-id>` with the reason `team-kit baseline` and ratchet that marker in .agents/ratchet.json.
